podcast.body: Released two months before early 2019, this album is described as having significant energy and a communal feeling, effectively integrating elements and lessons learned from the band's previous records. The spontaneous and open studio approach taken during the creation of the single "Knockin' at the Door" served as an inspiration for the recording sessions of this album. "How do you describe it? Yeah, I think being so close to it is hard to totally describe it, but I can tell you the feeling of it because we're playing a lot live. I think that it has a lot of energy and I think there's a certain kind of like communal energy to the record and I think it brings together a lot of the elements from all the records we've discussed in a really great way."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
